```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# Initialize the Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemMulticore()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # Gravity

# Create FEA beam mesh
fea_mesh = chrono.ChMesh()
fea_mesh.SetName("beam_mesh")

# Beam parameters
beam_length = 1.0  # meters
num_elements = 10
element_length = beam_length / num_elements

# Create nodes
nodes = []
for i in range(num_elements + 1):
    x = i * element_length
    node = chrono.ChNodeFEAxyzDD()
    node.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(x, 0, 0))
    fea_mesh.AddNode(node)
    nodes.append(node)

# Create beam elements (ANCF beam elements)
for i in range(num_elements):
    node1 = nodes[i]
    node2 = nodes[i+1]
    element = chrono.ChElementBeamANCF()
    element.SetNodes(node1, node2)
    # Material properties (steel)
    element.Set_E(200e9)       # Young's modulus
    element.Set_G(76.9e9)      # Shear modulus
    element.Set_density(7850)  # Density (kg/m^3)
    # Cross-sectional properties (square beam 0.1m x 0.1m)
    element.Set_section_area(0.01)  # Area (m^2)
    element.Set_section_I33(0.0001)  # Moment of inertia (I = bh^3/12)
    fea_mesh.AddElement(element)

system.Add(fea_mesh)

# Constraint: Fix the first node (clamped end)
fixed_node = nodes[0]
fixed_link = chrono.ChLinkLockPosition()
fixed_link.Initialize(fixed_node, None, chrono.ChFrameD())
system.AddLink(fixed_link)

# Motor setup for compressive load
# Create dummy body connected to last node
dummy_body = chrono.ChBody()
dummy_body.SetBodyFixed(False)
dummy_body.SetPos(nodes[-1].GetPos())
system.Add(dummy_body)

# Link dummy body to last node
link_point = chrono.ChLinkPointPoint()
link_point.Initialize(nodes[-1], dummy_body, chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0), chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0))
system.AddLink(link_point)

# Define compression motor function
class CompressionMotorFunction(chrono.ChFunction):
    def __init__(self, rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.rate = rate
    def Get_y(self, time):
        return -self.rate * time  # Negative X direction compression

motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorLinear()
motor.Initialize(dummy_body, system.Get_terrain(), chrono.ChVectorD(1,0,0), False)
motor.Set_yref(CompressionMotorFunction(0.001))  # Compression rate 0.001 m/s
system.AddLink(motor)

# Solver and timestepper configuration
system.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolver.Type_BARZILAIBORWEIN)
system.SetMaxItersSolverSpeed(100)
system.SetTolerance(1e-6)

stepper = chrono.ChTimestepperHHT(system)
stepper.SetAlpha(-0.2)
stepper.SetMaxiters(5)
stepper.SetAbsTolerances(1e-5)
stepper.SetRelTolerances(1e-3)
system.SetTimestepper(stepper)

# Visualization setup
visualizer = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
visualizer.AttachSystem(system)
visualizer.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
visualizer.SetWindowTitle('Beam Buckling Simulation')
visualizer.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)
visualizer.SetLightIntensity(0.8)
visualizer.SetCamera(chronoirr.ChVectorD(0, 3, 3))
visualizer.SetCameraRotation(chronoirr.Q_from_AngAxis(chrono.CH_C_PI/4, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0)))

# Add FEA mesh visualization
visual_mesh = chronoirr.ChVisualShapeFEA(fea_mesh)
visual_mesh.SetFEMdataType(chronoirr.ChVisualShapeFEMdataType.POSITION)
visual_mesh.SetFEMrenderMode(chronoirr.ChVisualShapeFEMrenderingMode.Mode_shape)
visual_mesh.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8,0.8,0.8))
visualizer.AddVisualShape(visual_mesh)

# Simulation loop
time_step = 0.001
time_end = 5.0

visualizer.SetTimeStep(time_step)
visualizer.Initialize()
visualizer.AddLogo()
visualizer.AddSkyBox()
visualizer.AddGrid()

while visualizer.Run():
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
    if system.GetChTime() > time_end:
        break
    visualizer.BeginScene()
    visualizer.DrawAll()
    visualizer.EndScene()

visualizer.Close()
```
